items.q: Is Astra one AGI event, or a news dump?
items.a: A **satirical recap** of the first week of Sept 2026: **Fable/Mythos 5.1 → Muse Spark 1.3 → GPT-6 Astra** in three days. Treat claims as **host-reported**. The story is cadence and rollout chaos as much as capability.

items.q: What is actually interesting about Fable 5.1 vs Mythos?
items.a: Same weights: **Fable is public**, Mythos is **Glass Wing / you can't use it**. The case study: Millennium crash dump → vendor binary → **assembly**. Protein-binder hit rate cited **~10% → ~50%** on the gated twin.

items.q: How is Meta competing if not on benches?
items.a: Muse Spark **contributor tier $0.10 / $0.20** vs standard **$1.25 / $4.25** — a huge discount if Meta **trains on your traffic**. Alexander Wang: a **double-digit** share of developers pick the cheap meter.

items.q: What does OpenAI actually pitch Astra as?
items.a: **Computer-use agents** (forms, KiCad, Blender): OSWorld **73% in ~40 min** vs Soul **65% in ~75 min**. First OpenAI model over the **critical cyber threshold** (autonomous zero-days). List price matches Fable: **$10 / $50**.

items.q: Why does the host say something doesn't add up?
items.a: Vendor numbers: Exploit Bench **100%**, ARC-AGI 3 **99%**. Artificial Analysis Independent Intelligence Index: **61** — **tied with GPT 5.6 Soul, 5 points behind Fable 5.1**. That is the **vendor-vs-independent** gap.
